correct_completion: she submitted it to the manager.
full_sentence: Having finished the report, she submitted it to the manager.
acceptable_variants: she sent it to the manager.
she handed it to her supervisor.

options.text: the manager had already left the office.
options.why_wrong: This switches to a new subject and adds no action by the person who finished the report, so it does not complete the participle clause.

options.text: she submitted it to the manager.

options.why_wrong: This repeats the finishing action already implied by 'Having finished', so it gives no new step to complete the sentence.
The participle clause needs a main clause about the same subject, and this option has no clear actor performing the next action.

grammar_focus: Perfect participle clauses with a shared subject
explanation: A perfect participle clause describes an action completed before the main action. The main clause must have the same subject as the participle and name the next action in the sequence.
translation: Raporu bitirdikten sonra onu yöneticisine teslim etti.
